heading: Response
text: You must return the school enrollment form by November 4, 2026.

heading: Documents
text: The student must provide proof of address and an immunization record.

heading: Meeting
text: The school meeting is on November 10, 2026 at 3 p.m. in Room 2.

heading: Language
text: You may ask the office for an interpreter.

heading: Terms
text: Enrollment means signing up for school.

heading: Contact
text: You must contact the school office to reschedule the meeting.
